summary: Reserve a configured worst-case credit cost before every AppTweak client HTTP attempt; reject unknown paths or exhausted budgets. An append-only limit extension preserves prior reservations in the same journal and hash chain.
reason: The full live dogfood has no native credit ceiling and shared credits require a hard gate before paid calls.
validated_outcome: Focused guard tests, including limit-extension reservation preservation, pass offline; no paid call was made for this patch.
